# NORD-10

NORD-10 / NORD-10/S micro program (MICMAC), 32-bit word

- **Name for `%#MODEL` and the settings:** `nd10`
- **Also accepted:** `nord10`, `nord-10`, `nd-10`
- **Word width in the bit view:** 32 bits
- **Image written by *Assemble*:** prom.hex text and 32-bit big-endian .CODE
- **Ending of the image file:** `.hex`
- **Mnemonics:** 197
- **Colours shared with:** NORD-10
- **Definitions:** [`defs/tokens/nd10-tokens.yaml`](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta/blob/main/defs/tokens/nd10-tokens.yaml)

## How the bits are given

The word is 2 groups of 16 bits. Each group is written as 6 octal digits, most significant group first. Groups that are all zero are left out of the tables below. A mnemonic sets the bits that are 1 in its groups; the mnemonics of one instruction are ORed together.

## Fields of the word

`control_store_words` in the definitions: 1024, 4096.

### a_operand

| Mnemonic | Bits | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `A,Z` | all zero | Zero as A-operand |  |
| `A,D` | `000001` (bits 15-0) | D register as A-operand |  |
| `A,P` | `000002` (bits 15-0) | CP register as A-operand |  |
| `A,B` | `000003` (bits 15-0) | B register as A-operand |  |
| `A,L` | `000004` (bits 15-0) | L register as A-operand |  |
| `A,A` | `000005` (bits 15-0) | A register as A-operand |  |
| `A,T` | `000006` (bits 15-0) | T register as A-operand |  |
| `A,X` | `000007` (bits 15-0) | X register as A-operand |  |
| `A,S` | `000010` (bits 15-0) | STATUS as A-operand |  |
| `A,DH` | `000011` (bits 15-0) | Lower 8 bits of H with sign extension as A operand |  |
| `A,IO` | `000012` (bits 15-0) | Special Case: Internal Register specified as B-operand to H register |  |
| `A,H` | `000013` (bits 15-0) | H register as A-operand |  |
| `A,SCR` | `000014` (bits 15-0) | SCRATCH register as A-operand |  |
| `A,R` | `000015` (bits 15-0) | R register as A-operand |  |
| `A,SP` | `000016` (bits 15-0) | SAVED P as A-operand |  |
| `A,SS` | `000017` (bits 15-0) | SAVED STATUS as A-operand |  |
